title: Shut Variations
vars: The one you chose, for reference.
Shut without the hum. Just the hit and the room.
The hum stays to 1.6 s before it cuts, so the cut lands after the room has died.
The low note stronger and longer under the hit.
A second slowed click 180 ms after, quieter. Two parts to the mechanism.
A fainter copy 0.4 s later, in a slightly bigger room. Something further away answers.
The smallest room of all, almost no air around it.
